Three valid Copilot findings on PR #526 — one more commit, push when green:

1. (security-adjacent) repairAdditive's atomicWrite always chmods 0644 — an operator's 0600 archetype/role becomes group/other-readable merely because a shipped key was missing, where the old no-clobber path never touched it. Preserve the existing file's mode on additive repair (stat before, apply to the temp file before rename) + a test asserting a 0600 file stays 0600 after repair.

2. topLevelMapping's second Decode treats ANY non-nil error as end-of-stream, so malformed trailing YAML passes the single-document gate — and the same helper runs in post-merge verification. Accept only io.EOF as "single document"; any other error or a successful second decode = not a candidate (empty reason, per the never-candidate rule from dc0fcd5). Test: a file with garbage after a `---` separator declines.

3. docs/seed-content-upgrade.md: the earlier sections (opening model + the untracked-files rule) still state that upgrades apply only to manifest-tracked files and every untracked existing file is a plain no-clobber skip — a reader stops before reaching your amendment. Update those earlier statements to reference the additive-repair exception where they state the old absolute (and fix the stale source-line references the thread mentions).

make check, commit, push, reply done with sha. I'm re-running the macOS CI job meanwhile (infra TLS flake, unrelated).
